fee_notes: Royalty: 5% of Gross Revenues or $300/month, greater. Local Advertising: $750/month minimum (not to franchisor ad fund). System Advertising Fee: $250/month or 1% of Gross Revenues, greater. Franchise Support Fee: $1,500/month or 2% of Gross Revenues, greater (dispatch, comms, software, support). Third-party software ~$800/year (~$67/month) plus transaction costs.
